cik:0001940981.author: Claude
cik:0001940981.why: The filing reports $29.9M sold of a $36.8M offering, tagged as both equity and debt, and it does not say how much was which. Calling it an equity raise would overstate what is known. It was filed 7 days after the 15-day deadline, which is a fact to note and not evidence of a problem. For a founder benchmarking round sizes, treat the number as total capital in a mixed offering, not as an equity valuation signal.
cik:0001940981.watch: Whether Nanopath announces the round with investors and the instrument split. A Form D names no investors; the four related persons listed are the company's own officers and directors.
basis: Form D 0001940981-26-000003: securities offered flagged as equity and debt; offering $36,760,740; sold $29,891,706; remaining $6,869,034; 21 investors.
First sale 2026-10-22 gives a 2026-11-06 deadline; the filing date from EDGAR's index is 2026-11-13; signature date 2026-11-10.

cik:0001704292.author: Claude
cik:0001704292.why: Zai Lab has an exchange ticker (Nasdaq: ZLAB) and files 10-Qs, so this is a private placement by a public company, sold in full to 25 investors with a $7.5M placement fee to Leerink Partners (3.0% of the amount sold). It is not a startup financing and should not be used as a benchmark for early-stage rounds. It is more useful as a signal of how much capital institutional investors are putting into a listed biotech.
cik:0001704292.watch: Any 8-K or press release describing the terms and use of proceeds. This pipeline does not read those yet.
basis: EDGAR company record for CIK 1704292: ticker ZLAB, exchange Nasdaq, SIC 2834, large accelerated filer, 10-Q filed 2026-08-06.
Form D 0001704292-26-000038: $249,933,600 offered and sold, $0 remaining, 25 investors, commissions $7,498,008 to Leerink Partners LLC.
First sale 2026-10-27; filed 2026-11-09, inside the 15-day deadline.

cik:0002164579.author: Claude
cik:0002164579.why: This is a startup financing, not debt: the filing tags it as an option to acquire and the broker note describes the securities as SAFEs. It reports $16.3M sold to 94 investors, and the company says a placement agent (Cedar Point Capital) earned a 10% fee on the SAFEs it sold, which implies roughly $7.6M came through that broker (derived: $760,900 divided by 10%). The first sale was 2025-10-09 and the form was signed 2026-11-10, 382 days past the 15-day deadline, so this is a year of cumulative SAFE sales reported at once, not a new raise this week. Whether the lateness has any legal consequence is a question for counsel.
cik:0002164579.watch: Whether an amended Form D or a priced equity round follows, since SAFEs convert at the next priced round. The company's own announcements are the place to look; this pipeline does not track them.
basis: Form D 0002164579-26-000001: securities offered flagged only as option to acquire; offering $20,000,000; sold $16,314,000; 94 investors; commission $760,900 to Cedar Point Capital, LLC.
Filer note on the commission: '10% of the proceeds received from the sale of SAFEs by the Broker'.
First sale 2025-10-09 gives a 2025-10-24 deadline; signed and filed 2026-11-10.

fda:deep-breathe.author: Claude
fda:deep-breathe.why: FDA's own summary calls BlineSlide an AI-assisted tool, so the AI label is supported by the document. The method is not settled: the summary's comparison table lists both computer vision and machine-learning-based algorithms, and the extracted text does not show which device each belongs to. It is a reading aid for lung ultrasound (absent pleural line motion), cleared against a fetal-ultrasound predicate (Sonio Suspect, K243614) under a product code FDA names for cancer-lesion diagnostic software. The summary also cites the company's earlier BlineSlide clearance (K252007, product code QIH). The applicant's address is London, CA with a Canadian-format postal code. For a founder, it is a worked example of clearing an ultrasound AI tool through a predicate from a different specialty, and of a Canadian company doing so.
fda:deep-breathe.watch: Whether FDA adds K261679 to its AI-enabled device list at the next update, and whether the summary's performance figures (standalone sensitivity 0.94, specificity 0.87 on 818 cines; reader study aided AUC 0.922 vs 0.855 unaided) show up in the company's own claims.
basis: FDA record K261679: received 2026-05-21, decided 2026-10-23 (155 days), traditional 510(k), no predetermined change control plan authorized, product code POK (regulation 892.2060).

510(k) summary: indicated as a concurrent reading aid for lung ultrasound in adults; describes an AI-assisted tool; algorithm methodology row lists computer vision and machine-learning-based algorithms (column mapping unclear); predicate Sonio Suspect K243614 (machine learning based, fetal ultrasound); reference device BlineSlide K252007.
Applicant address on the FDA record: 45 King St., London, CA N6A1B8.
